text:
Lena: Quick sync — HelioTech wants the contract signoff path documented. They insisted on SSO + BYO-KMS + EU data residency clause. Deal size ~ $1.2M ARR. Can legal weigh in on acceptable timeline?
Sanjay: POC wraps this Fri. Metrics look good so far. Their security team sent over a questionnaire: https://drive.redwood/helio/helio-security-q.xlsx — it's mostly standard but KMS + logs questions are prominent.
Aisha: Adding myself. I need the redlined T&Cs and the proposed KMS language. Also confirm log ownership & retention. I can turn around an initial redline by EOD tomorrow.
Marcos: SSO via SAML is ready on our side. BYO-KMS is supported for Dedicated/Private; hosted has a proxy pattern we need to enable. They also want region pinning to EU-only. Ops, can you confirm control-plane isolation options?
Tyler: @Aisha @Marcos we need an internal-approved path — don't want to lose momentum. Can we ship an NDA + ‘commitment letter’ this week while legal finishes redlines?
deploy-bot: Document shared: https://drive.redwood/helio/commitment-draft-v2.pdf
Aisha: I can approve the commitment letter with two edits: add a 'no-elevation-of-privilege' warranty and bump the insurance floor to $5M. I'll paste suggested language in a sec.
Lena: Please paste it here and I'll run it by Helio's counsel immediately.
Aisha: ```No-Elevation Warranty: Vendor represents that changes to access controls will not permit elevation of privileges beyond the scope required for HelioTech's production use. Insurance: Vendor will maintain general liability insurance with limits no less than $5,000,000 per occurrence.```
Marcos: Ops confirms BYO-KMS onboarding flow exists for Dedicated/Private. For hosted, enabling BYO-KMS requires a small proxy service; engineering ETA ~ 3 business days to enable the proxy and KMS rotations.
Sanjay: POC acceptance criteria we've aligned on: 99% API availability during test window, p50 latency < 120ms for 512-token calls, embeddings recall >= 0.92 on our eval set. Helio verbally agreed — let's lock them into the commitment letter.
Tyler: Also note pricing: Helio requested a 12% list discount for a 3-year commit. Finance or pricing ops, can someone take this?
ops-bot: Pricing request ticket created: PR-4821 — owner assigned.
Lena: Action items summary: Aisha to redline commitment letter; Marcos to confirm region isolation docs & KMS onboarding steps; Sanjay to freeze POC metrics and upload logs; Finance to respond on discount. Target signoff by Tue next week — Helio execs need an update for their board Wed.
Aisha: I'll have the redline posted by EOD tomorrow. If they push on insurance scope we'll need a short call.
Marcos: Region isolation doc uploaded: https://internal.redwood/regions/eu-pin. Ops will draft VPN peering + private endpoint steps in that doc.
Sanjay: Uploading final POC logs and evaluation notebook to shared drive now. Will tag the exact cells we used for recall numbers.
Tyler: If legal + ops are green, I'll prep the executive summary and route the commitment letter for signatures.
Lena: @Marcos can you drop the KMS onboarding snippet here so Helio's infra team can review?
Marcos: ```bash
# KMS onboarding (example)
redwood-kms onboard --customer helio --region eu --mode byo 
# returns: onboarding-token -> send to customer KMS admin for key wrapping
```
Sanjay: Helio CISO asked for SOC2 scope and ISO cert links — I responded with certs and the SOC2 scoping note.
Lena: I'll schedule a signoff call with Helio legal Mon 10am (tentative) and send a calendar invite. If anything shifts I'll update here.
Tyler: :thumbsup: keep me posted. If anything blocks, escalate to me and I'll join the call.
